author: Retro Game Corps
description:
With PC gaming apps like GameNative and GameHub getting better and better, are they at the point where Android handhelds can be a viable Steam Deck replacement?  In this video I test the most popular Steam Deck PC games to see how they perform without any settings configurations.

GameNative: https://gamenative.app/
GameNative guide: https://youtu.be/a9ZlYhgnI-g
TechDweeb's guide:  https://youtu.be/CHVHFR6U9dQ
GameHub: https://gamehub.xiaoji.com/
GameHub Lite: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite
Slay the Spire 2 for Android: https://github.com/Ekyso/StS2-Launcher
